not_implemented_or_not_established: Automatic paper ingestion, agent scheduling, source/dependency search and production model runners.
Shared draft assembler, real record/envelope persistence and identity authentication for this example.
Complete RecordSet closure and actual source-byte provenance for this example.
Resolution of view/plan/snapshot membership, assumption contexts and mathematical rule correctness by the new checker.
Parsing generated Lean declarations and verifying expected-declaration coverage or node-to-code semantic correspondence.
Isolated Lean build service and independently authenticated formal-check receipts.
Independent scientific argument review, source-blind backtranslation, semantic alignment or release acceptance of a paper.
A guarantee that different models produce identical proofs or mathematical content.
Registry enforcement: check_interfaces.py does not read registry/trusted-packages.json and does not check imports against it.
Target-name baseline persistence: --expect-target-names accepts a caller-supplied digest map; no host-side freeze store exists.

NO MACHINE INTERCEPTION for a statement rewritten under an unchanged declaration name (CONFORMANCE E10). The name digest hashes the draft declaration field, a fully qualified name, not the statement; and #print axioms is unchanged when a theorem is weakened to a still-provable one. Catching this needs the elaborated type from a real Lean run. Until then the R3b statement red line is human plus R3 trusted-target comparison, with R4/R5 as backstop.

Import-versus-registry enforcement of the physlib PhyslibAlpha restriction: lake defaultTargets constrains only builds inside physlib, not downstream imports, so PhyslibAlpha remains importable until our own import scanner exists.
Forbidden-construct scanning is textual: comments and docstrings can trigger warnings and macros or notation can evade it; it is a warning, not a proof of absence.
Audit parsing checks only '#print axioms' text; it does not run Lean, verify toolchain identity or log authenticity, or check declaration coverage.
No CI integration of this module's checks; no tracked bootstrap or single environment lock for the Lean toolchain.
